name: layer
summary: Places a foreground region over base content through local grid layering.

agent.useWhen: A badge, annotation, control, or comparison must share the base content area.
agent.avoidWhen: Content should interrupt the page or protect focus; use a dialog instead.

invariants: Required base precedes foreground in DOM order.
Foreground non-control surface does not block base interactions.
Neutral wrappers add no landmarks, controls, scripts, routes, or commands.
